concerns.text: Spec FR-002 and US-2 explicitly require log-transformation of resolution times before distribution fitting and outlier detection. Tasks T017a-1 through T017a-3 implement IQR-based outlier detection on the 'global dataset' without a preceding task to apply the required log-transform, leaving the spec requirement for log-transformed outlier detection unimplemented.

Spec US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires reporting the number and percentage of extreme outliers detected via the IQR method. Task T017 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) and lacks the implementation of the required `data/processed/outlier_report.json` artifact generation, leaving a core success criterion unverified.

Spec FR-007 mandates a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} and reporting stability proportions. Task T025c is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) and lacks the implementation of the required `data/processed/sensitivity_report.json` artifact, meaning the project cannot demonstrate compliance with the specified threshold sweep.

Spec FR-003 requires excluding invalid issues and logging them. Tasks T011 (Save cleaned dataset) and T012 (Add logging for excluded issues) are marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). Without these tasks, there is no evidence the cleaning pipeline executed or produced the required analysis-ready dataset (`data/processed/cleaned_issues.csv`) and log (`data/logs/preprocessing.log`).

Task descriptions T017a-1 to T017a-3 reference 'global dataset' and 'IQR method' but do not explicitly reference the spec requirement (US-2 Scenario 3) or the plan element (Phase 2) they satisfy, making traceability ambiguous compared to other tasks that explicitly cite FR/SC IDs.
